17 OCTOBER 2026 · PORTFOLIO UPDATE

Bringing four projects online

My current work spans React and TypeScript, the MERN stack, Flutter and Firebase, and Python with Flask. I’m bringing those projects together here so visitors can explore the actual applications as well as their source.

Shape Up and EduPredict now have checked account and personal data flows. TechNova’s catalog and cart are available as a web demo. Commecs AI Assistant continues to provide a conversational interface to public college material.

My next focus is improving remaining integrations and workflows. Shape Up’s external AI service/API is currently unavailable; the case study records that clearly. I’ll update this portfolio as the projects develop.
